content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication documents a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period, as stated in the ordering note. We request that SilverBridge reconsider the precertification denial on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
